raw_generation:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=1.
NUMBER right=4.
LOOP (left<=right) { NUMBER middle=(left+right)/2. IF (middle*middle>values[0]) { left=middle+1. } ELSE { right=middle-1. } }
NUMBER left2=1.
NUMBER right2=4.
LOOP (left2<=right2) { NUMBER middle=(left2+right2)/2. IF (middle*middle>values[1]) { left2=middle+1. } ELSE { right2=middle-1. } }
NUMBER left3=1.
NUMBER right3=4.
LOOP (left3<=right3) { NUMBER middle=(left3+right3)/2. IF (middle*middle>values[2]) { left3=middle+1. } ELSE { right3=middle-1. } }
NUMBER left4=1.
NUMBER right4=4.
LOOP (left4<=right4) { NUMBER middle=(left4+right4)/2. IF (middle*middle>values[3]) { left4=middle+1. } ELSE { right4=middle-1. } }
NUMBER[] sizes=[left,right,left3,right4].
NUMBER max=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (sizes[i]>max) { max=sizes[i]. } }
DISPLAYNL(max).

task_metadata.prompt: Read four pipe-separated numbers. Determine how many array positions satisfy the property entry whose square exceeds four. Print that count plus 1.
